spec.scope: Heal-over-time (no damage scope); amounts scale the SKILL USER's final Max HP, not each target's

spec.triggerIdentity: fullBurstEnter — 'when entering Full Burst' fires on ANY team Full Burst, not only rotations Mary bursts. The escalating counter counts FB ENTRIES (team-wide), a distinct counter from skill2's burst-use counter
spec.targetSet: allies (all 5, including self) — every ally receives the recovery events, so every ally's 'recovery' trigger fires
spec.nearestWrongModel: Skipped as 'defensive heal, no damage' (isolation-inert), or encoded as a single instant heal (ticks:1) instead of a 5-tick HoT — either starves teammate on-recovery consumers (Crown's 'when recovery takes effect' is IN the control fixture as B2)

Red under skip (0) and under instant-heal (1/2/3). Also assert every comp slug appears as a recovery recipient, not just self
spec.inertness: Zero direct damage events from this block (heal carries no damage); with NO on-recovery consumer in the comp, totals must be bit-identical with the block removed

loadBearingSet: skill1:fullBurstEnter escalating 5-tick HoT ladder (tandem feed for on-recovery consumers — Crown is the fixture's B2)
notes: Three reconciliation points where I expect a shared-prior misread. (1) FIXTURE VALIDITY: Mary is BURST I — controlComp(carry) seats the carry in the B3 slot, where a B1 unit either never casts or must compete with liter (also B1) for the stage-1 cast; if liter wins first-ready selection every rotation, Mary's skill2 AND both burst blocks are silent and every burstCast assertion vacuously passes as 0. The tests MUST build a comp with Mary as the actual B1 caster (replace liter) and assert she actually emits burstCast events before asserting anything downstream. (2) TWO DISTINCT ESCALATION COUNTERS: skill1 counts team FB ENTRIES (fullBurstEnter), skill2 counts HER burst USES (burstCast) — in a comp where Mary skips a rotation these counters diverge; a model sharing one counter or one trigger is the prime shared misread, and 'Each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it' means steps 1..N are ALL applied (the engine 'escalating' kind), not just step N. (3) The two burst ■ blocks have DIFFERENT target clauses (Water-only ATK vs all-allies HP) and DIFFERENT durations (3s vs 10s) — conflating either axis is the nearest-wrong for both lines. Also confirm the elemental stat is elemAdvantageDamagePct specifically: it is live in the Fire-boss control fixture but must die on a non-advantaged boss — an elementDamagePct/attackDamagePct encoding passes the advantaged fixture and silently over-credits elsewhere, so a non-advantaged-boss inertness run is the discriminating test. Heal magnitudes (% of caster Max HP) are engine-unmodeled by design (heal carries no HP amount) — the assertable surface is recovery-event COUNT/timing, via a patched on-recovery sentinel, not amounts; note the burst's own +27.87% Max HP self-grant raising her S1 heal amounts is therefore inherently inert.
